title: mount: buildah panics when parsing malformed mount options
body:
### Issue Description

The `buildah build` command panics when parsing a Containerfile having a malformed `--mount` option.


### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue

```bash
# file: test.sh
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT

buildah \
  --root "$tmpdir/root" \
  --runroot "$tmpdir/runroot" \
  --storage-driver vfs \
  build \
  --pull=never \
  --isolation=chroot \
  --file Containerfile
```

```Containerfile
# file: Containerfile
FROM scratch
RUN --mount=type=secret,id echo hello world
```

### Describe the results you received

Describe the results you received
`panic: runtime error: index out of range [1] with length 1`

### Describe the results you expected

Describe the results you expected
Issue to be handled properly
